purpose: Teach: 神浦/杉村/野坂/荒井/北野/日高/牛尾/広瀬

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 神浦部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get started on preparing the welcome reception for Section Chief Kamiura.
lines.style: Efficient, purposeful opening. Crisp articulation. Sets the agenda. Warmth underneath the briskness — this is collaborative work, not orders.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。杉村課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll check over Manager Sugimura's handover notes.
lines.style: Attentive, matching her tempo. Quick and capable. Slight lift at the end — confirming understanding and readiness to move forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 野坂技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: We should also share the project status update from Nosaka, our technical lead.
lines.style: Clear directive, same confident pace. Slight emphasis on 'share' — inviting collaboration. Lean into the next item naturally.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。荒井広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll review the monthly planning documents from Arai in PR.
lines.style: Steady, accepting the task. No hesitation. Clean, professional cadence. The rhythm of people who work well together.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 北野顧問との面談を予定しましょう
lines.en: And let's schedule a meeting with Advisor Kitano.
lines.style: Same assured tone, building the list. Slight pause before the name — treating it with appropriate weight. Matter-of-fact confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。日高経理の決算予定を整えます
lines.en: I'll get the closing timeline organised with Hidaka from accounting.
lines.style: Keeping pace. Slight nod in the voice — 'I've got this.' Professional but not stiff. The ease of someone who knows their role.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 牛尾人事に新人研修プランを依頼しましょう
lines.en: We should also reach out to Ushio in HR about getting the new employee training plan in motion.
lines.style: Still directive, same energy. Slight warming — new hire training is important work. Crisp but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広瀬法務に新契約レビューを依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll have Legal review the new contracts with Hirose.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Clean, definite. Small satisfaction in the voice — the last item checked off. Ready to execute.
